description: This file implements the TelemetryImplementation class for managing telemetry data, event reporting, privacy settings, and integration with RBus and PowerManager. It includes methods for registering notifications, handling power state changes, uploading and aborting reports, and setting report profiles.

classes.name: TelemetryImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing telemetry functionalities, including event handling, report management, privacy settings, and external system integration.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the telemetry system with the provided service, sets up power management, privacy, and report profiles.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for telemetry events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: SetReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the report profile to STARTED or COMPLETE.

methods.name: LogApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event with a name and value.

methods.name: UploadReport
methods.description: Triggers the upload of telemetry report via RBus.

methods.name: AbortReport
methods.description: Aborts the ongoing telemetry report upload via RBus.
